name: litigation-deadline-calendar
description: Calendar litigation and arbitration deadlines from a scheduling order. Parses a PDF scheduling order, identifies key dates, computes backward deadlines using the applicable rules (Colorado CRCP, Federal FRCP, or arbitration forum rules for AAA/JAMS), and generates an .ics calendar file for Outlook or Google Calendar import. Use this skill whenever the user mentions: litigation deadlines, scheduling order, case management order, deadline calendaring, discovery deadlines, trial preparation deadlines, arbitration scheduling, or anything related to computing or tracking court or arbitration deadlines. Also trigger when the user uploads a PDF that appears to be a court scheduling order or arbitration scheduling order.
